items.title: Capture a production-path RED for quorum metadata residue
items.context: From a clean story worktree with current signed reviewer passes, run the local CLI quorum_submit and prove six verdict rows are emitted while process-events.jsonl remains dirty; prove the next validation persistence boundary refuses this pre-existing dirt without accepting a false PASS.

happy.desc: Production-path RED: in a clean real story worktree with current signed reviewer passes, invoke the worktree-local CLI quorum_submit and assert exactly six current-round host_verdict rows are appended while .lattice/story/actives/B-6ed2/process-events.jsonl remains a tracked dirty path; record before/after HEAD, byte length, row identities and git status so the failure is the real handler path, not a mocked helper.

Immediately cross the real validation persistence boundary after that RED and assert validation executes but refuses canonical PASS persistence because the quorum residue pre-existed its transaction; no PASS receipt, validation_terminal PASS, or clean-tree claim may be produced.

edge.desc: Prove the RED is deterministic from a clean baseline: repeating the fixture setup yields the same six-row causal delta and dirty process-events path without unrelated source/config changes.

Inspect all six emitted rows and prove they bind the intended three rounds by two distinct hosts to the current material/story-files/prompt/validation identity; duplicate or stale rows do not count toward the observed batch.

adversarial.desc: Seed process-events.jsonl with unrelated pre-existing bytes before quorum_submit and prove neither quorum_submit nor the following validate launders those bytes into a trusted commit or accepts PASS.

Inject a concurrent foreign append between quorum emission and the next persistence boundary and prove exact-byte/HEAD checks expose the race; no false PASS and no partial trusted quorum are accepted.
Assert the RED harness fails if it uses the global/main runtime, a fake store, direct handler-only shortcut, or fewer than six exact host_verdict rows, preserving production-path authority.

items.title: Persist the quorum verdict batch as one exact metadata transaction
items.context: Commit only the causally generated process-events delta for the quorum invocation. Recheck HEAD/content before commit; pre-existing or concurrent unrelated/user dirt is never staged. Hook/commit/CAS failures roll back all six verdict rows and produce no partial quorum.

happy.desc: From a clean index/worktree and stable HEAD, quorum_submit appends the bounded six-row three-round-by-two-host verdict batch and creates exactly one local commit whose diff contains only that invocation causal delta in the canonical process-events.jsonl; output reports the commit SHA and the worktree is clean afterward.

The committed six rows retain their signed reviewer-run, round, distinct-host, current materialHash/storyFilesHash, promptDigest and validationDigest bindings, and the assurance evaluator counts a complete 3x2 quorum only after the commit succeeds.

edge.desc: The transaction snapshots entry HEAD, index status, canonical file identity and exact before-bytes; immediately before staging/commit it rechecks HEAD and content and stages only the exact process-events path, never broad-add semantics.

A repeated identical quorum_submit after the successful commit is idempotent: it does not append another six rows or create a no-op/duplicate commit, and reports the already-satisfied/refused disposition without changing quorum count.
A failed first attempt that fully rolls back can be retried from the restored baseline and then produces one six-row commit, with neither duplicate residue nor stale transaction state.

adversarial.desc: Any pre-existing dirty/staged source, config, user file, lifecycle metadata, or process-events bytes causes refusal before durable verdict persistence; none of that dirt is staged or committed and no quorum is newly counted.

A foreign append or byte mutation after emission but before commit fails the exact-content/CAS check; rollback removes only the command causal six rows, preserves competing bytes verbatim, and leaves no partial quorum or PASS-equivalent assurance.
HEAD movement between baseline capture and commit fails closed before commit; the moved HEAD is preserved, no commit is attributed to quorum_submit, and all six generated rows disappear together.
Commit-hook rejection or git commit failure is not bypassed with no-verify; the index is restored and all six generated verdict rows are rolled back atomically, so assurance remains incomplete.

If rollback itself detects a CAS/content conflict, it must not overwrite or truncate foreign bytes; surface a structured rollback-conflict/infra failure and ensure no subset of the six rows can satisfy the 3x2 gate.

items.title: Bind adversarial regression and process-fact coverage
items.context: Cover clean success, duplicate refusal, pre-dirty metadata, foreign append, commit hook failure, rollback conflict and idempotent retry. Update process-fact/runtime contracts only where gate-consumed quorum persistence semantics require it.

happy.desc: A focused regression drives the worktree-local quorum_submit production CLI from clean signed current-round reviewer passes and asserts one atomic six-row commit, clean post-state, complete 3x2 local-review-quorum, and no Authority/production completion overclaim.

Because atomic quorum persistence is gate-consumed semantics, the process-fact registry and verify-process-fact-contract projection explicitly bind quorum_submit, host_verdict/local-review-quorum, atomic persistence/refusal behavior and its gate consumer; the runtime-fact registry remains unchanged unless an actual environment fact is introduced.

edge.desc: Regression covers duplicate submission after success: no duplicate rows or commit are created and the already-complete quorum remains exactly three rounds by two distinct hosts.
Regression covers idempotent retry after a fully rolled-back infra failure: retry succeeds once, produces exactly six durable rows, and does not inherit partial state from the failed attempt.

Process-fact contract/vocabulary fingerprint tests are updated together with registry semantics and pass alongside the focused quorum test, without weakening unrelated receipt, validation, review, or Authority facts.

adversarial.desc: Regression seeds pre-dirty process-events metadata and separately unrelated staged/user dirt; quorum_submit refuses both before a trusted commit, preserves bytes/index, and cannot make the assurance gate PASS.

Regression injects a foreign append/content mutation during the transaction; CAS failure preserves foreign bytes and yields zero durable generated rows or a structured rollback conflict, never a partial countable quorum.
Regression forces commit-hook/git commit failure without bypassing hooks; exact rollback restores file and index baseline, emits no quorum commit, and leaves the gate incomplete.
Regression forces rollback conflict and asserts fail-closed diagnostics expose both primary and rollback failure while refusing to overwrite competing content or count any subset of the six verdicts.
Regression moves HEAD at the pre-commit boundary and asserts CAS refusal, no generated commit, all-or-none verdict durability, and no validation/review receipt is synthesized to mask the failure.
